title: A direct one-sided signed rough-pair margin
objective: Attempt an actual parity-sensitive one-sided estimate for the original signed rough-pair target, using the completed evidence to avoid false polynomial lifts and composite-input substitutions; retain any proved new arithmetic lemma or a precise first failure.
deliverables: At most two direct pointwise mechanisms
A proved load-bearing arithmetic statement or exact failed inequality
Full original prime/semiprime/triple and error accounting
success_criteria: The true one-sided prime target remains the research objective
No average or composite-only bound is promoted to a pointwise margin
Every character or operator estimate preserves its actual support and normalization
A conditional restatement of Goldbach is not called a breakthrough
stop_conditions: One pair round within8 proxy units
No paid calls, publication, external messages or unbounded computation
No goal completion without full independent mathematical and scope verification
